# The record

What Silo writes down about a computer, and what it may do with it.

## For

To know what happened in a computer without trusting anything inside it, and to act on it without
letting something that can be wrong do harm.

## Why it is so

- **Three ways of knowing** (`fact`, `report`, `opinion`), because they differ in one thing:
  whether they can be wrong. A fact cannot. A report is what the inside said. An opinion is a
  judgement.
- **Two ways of acting** (`rule`, `precaution`), because a wrong grant cannot be taken back and a
  wrong pause only costs time (`less-sure-less-power`).
- **Opinions are kept apart from the record.** A better classifier then replaces a worse one, the
  opinions are computed again, and nothing is migrated.

## One example

A rule allows crates.io, and another alerts on any new host. A program in the computer connects
to paste.rs. No rule allows it, so it is denied, and you are alerted.
